title: ElevenLabs Voice Library
one_liner: Share a professional clone of your voice and earn when paid users use it.
followers: None. Needs a Professional Voice Clone (Creator plan or higher).
pay: Paid only when paid users use your voice; Stripe payout, usually from $10; about 60 countries; W-8/W-9 needed.
steps: Record clean audio and make a Professional Voice Clone.
Share it in the Voice Library with a clear description.
Connect Stripe and fill the tax form.
catch: A paid plan comes first, and most voices earn little; only clone your own voice.

match.first_step: Record 30 minutes of clean audio in a quiet room.
